remit: underpriced hawkish policy, higher terminal rates, or higher-rate repricing
stance_summary: US inflation, labor, activity and consumer heat are still inconsistent with a SOFR path that peaks at 4.755 in 2027-09 and then eases through 2028. Pay SOFR_2027-09 (long implied rate at the packet 4.755 mid) rather than USD spot, because the mispricing is the policy path itself. Fact: Fed delivered 25bp to 3.75-4.00% and SOFR printed 3.85 on 2026-09-17. Inference: that first hike was a waypoint, not the terminal. Unknown: positioning.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Long implied-rate SOFR_2027-09 (CME SR3U7). Packet tradable-curve / 12m exact-horizon mid is 4.755, 90.5bp above overnight SOFR 3.85. This pays the priced terminal and rejects the subsequent 2028 fade (SR3H8 4.695, SR3U8 4.62).
expression_comparison.spot_candidate: Long USDJPY at the packet ECB mid 157.88830715532288 as the USD policy-premium alternative to the same hawkish-US view.
expression_comparison.rationale: The discrepancy is the SOFR path: a 4.755 2027-09 peak and a 2028 easing tail after a just-delivered hike into still-hot US gauges. SOFR_2027-09 is a locked, packet-markable implied-rate contract. USDJPY is inferior because it mixes that US path with the BoJ hike to 1.25% and a 1.41% one-day USDJPY jump already in the freeze, so spot does not isolate underpriced US restraint.

context_build.causal_mechanism: FACT: US temperature gauges remain hot (Inflation 72, Labor 75, Activity 69, Consumer 74), August CPI kept a Fed tightening bias intact, and the Fed raised 25bp to 3.75-4.00%. MECHANISM TESTED: inflation persistence plus still-firm demand/labor keep the reaction function hiking, so the terminal overnight rate and the date of first easing both reprice higher than the locked SR3 strip. INFERENCE: a path that peaks at 4.755 by 2027-09 and then eases through 2028 assumes a cooling that the retained heat scores have not confirmed. UNKNOWN: the composition of August CPI beyond the retained headline, and whether dashboard_v8 gauges match a live Supabase pull.
context_build.path_to_current_price: FACT: Official NY Fed SOFR held in a 3.50-3.69 range from mid-May through 2026-09-16 (3.62 that day) and then printed 3.85 effective 2026-09-17, a 23bp overnight jump coincident with the delivered hike. Pre-decision, interest-rate futures carried a greater-than-90% probability of that 25bp increase. The tradable SR3 strip now reads 2026-09 4.00, 2026-12 4.32, 2027-03 4.58, 2027-06 4.72, 2027-09 4.755 (peak, +90.5bp vs overnight), 2027-12 4.73, 2028-03 4.695, 2028-09 4.62. US 2Y 4.76 and 10Y 5.01 sit at the 99.8th and 99.6th one-year percentiles with 2s10s at 25bp (0.2nd percentile, -21bp over one month). INFERENCE: the front end did the hike that was already priced; the residual priced object is a shallow remaining cycle that fades inside 18 months. That is a path outcome, not a 2Y percentile thesis.
context_build.known_vs_new_information: KNOWN before the freeze: August CPI kept tightening bias intact; futures were already >90% priced for 25bp; US gauges were hot. NEW in this freeze: the hike was delivered to 3.75-4.00%; SOFR printed 3.85 on 2026-09-17; the locked strip still peaks at only 4.755 and then discounts 2028. The known CPI/hike facts can explain the overnight jump now because the fixing and the funds-range change are the transmission of already-telegraphed policy into the benchmark. They do not by themselves justify treating 4.755 as a sufficient terminal once heat remains this broad.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: The locked US policy path requires roughly 90bp of additional tightening from SOFR 3.85 to a 4.755 terminal by 2027-09, then about 6-13.5bp of easing by 2028-03/2028-09 (4.695/4.62), with 1m SOFR also peaking near 4.7225 in 2027-12 before fading. That is a one-year hiking cycle that stops below 5% and starts reversing in 2028. Cross-check: AONIA 4.35 prices only ~59.5bp more to a 4.945 2027-07/09 cap despite AU Inflation 82; CORRA 2.29 prices ~136.5bp more to a 3.655 2028-09 cap despite CA Labor 38 and core near 2%.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: Disagree specifically with the assumption that US restriction maxes at a 4.755 2027-09 implied rate and that 2028 forwards should already ease. The disagreed object is the SOFR terminal and the 2028 fade, not the statement that the first 25bp hike was likely.
context_build.price_decomposition: Level versus change: overnight SOFR is a new 3.85 level after a 23bp change on 2026-09-17; SR3U7 is a 4.755 level only 90.5bp above that overnight. Tenor split: 1m SOFR climbs from 3.75 (2026-09) to 4.7225 (2027-12) then fades; 3m SR3 peaks at 4.755 in 2027-09 then fades. Sovereign 2Y 4.76 is already at the SR3 terminal, while 10Y 5.01 and 30Y 5.34 hold extra term premium; 2s10s at 25bp (0.2nd percentile) is a discovery flag that the curve is flat, not a substitute for the SOFR path. Marginal driver of the latest overnight move is the delivered hike, not a new terminal-repricing impulse. Cross-market: CA-US 2Y at -140bp (3.8th percentile 1y) and CA-US 10Y at -111bp (0.2nd percentile 1y) show Canada still much easier; AU-US 2Y at +26bp (25.6th percentile 1y) shows Australia already tighter despite fewer remaining AONIA hikes.

historical_reference.regime_differences: 2022 analogs occurred during a still-accelerating inflation shock with policy starting from near-zero; today SOFR is already 3.85 after a delivered 25bp hike, US 2Y/10Y are already 99th-percentile, and a Saudi ship-to-ship workaround has reduced the extreme oil-supply tail. Australia now shows the housing channel biting (NSW stamp duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, Sydney/Melbourne values more than 7% below peak), which is a structural difference versus 2022 demand-led inflation. Those differences cut both ways: starting restriction is higher, so less residual tightening may be needed, but heat scores remain broad and the priced terminal is still only 4.755.

policy_path_check.rationale: This is an outright US STIR terminal trade. The frozen SOFR/SR3 path is the priced object; CORRA and AONIA are independent cross-checks that the hawkish residual is largest in the US remaining cycle relative to US heat, not a CA-US 2Y percentile substitute.

trade.structure: Pay 3-month SOFR / long implied rate in SOFR_2027-09 (SR3U7). Paper mark is the packet tradable-curve implied rate 4.755, not the 95.245 futures price. No strip weights: single locked contract.
trade.thesis: FACT: the Fed has hiked to 3.75-4.00%, SOFR is 3.85, and US heat scores are 72/75/69/74. FACT: SR3 still peaks at 4.755 in 2027-09 and eases into 2028. INFERENCE: inflation persistence keeps the terminal and the duration of restraint higher than that strip. Express the view by paying SOFR_2027-09. UNKNOWN: positioning and the next inflation print's composition.
trade.mispricing: SR3U7 at 4.755 prices only 90.5bp of remaining tightening from SOFR 3.85 and already allows a 2028 fade to 4.62. That is too little terminal and too early easing given still-hot US inflation, labor, activity and consumer gauges after a hike that was more than 90% priced going in.
why_now: Overnight SOFR jumped from 3.62 on 2026-09-16 to 3.85 on 2026-09-17, so the path now starts from the post-hike benchmark while the 12m exact-horizon SR3U7 mid is still 4.755.
The first 25bp hike was greater-than-90% priced before the decision; residual information is the terminal and 2028 fade, which have not been forced higher by the still-hot gauges.
Flat books still pay official SOFR 3.85 ACT/360 on the full $100m; SOFR_2027-09 is a packet-markable unfunded STIR expression of the hawkish residual.

Additional Fed communications that refuse to treat 3.75-4.00% as sufficient given still-hot gauges.
Re-acceleration of energy pass-through if the Saudi workaround fails to cap the oil tail.

US sovereign 2Y/10Y are already 99th-percentile; a growth scare or housing-channel transmission like Australia's could validate the 2028 easing tail.
Positioning is unavailable, so a crowded short-duration overlay cannot be ruled out.

BoJ hike to 1.25% and the 1.41% USDJPY one-day jump show USD spot can move for non-US reasons if the expression is ever swapped into FX.

conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: US inflation or labor data that keep the Fed hiking beyond the 4.755 2027-09 peak.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: SR3U7 implied rate back through the packet 4.58 6m mid, or a confirmed US labor/inflation cooldown.
